title: Leon's Vanilla++
description: A vanilla-like building and automation modpack
body:
![Vanilla++ modpack](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/e4508d235eec3eddc6293aa88e491aff750e95ac_0.webp)

A "**Vanilla++**" collection of mods

This modpack focuses on building and creativity with the aim to feel like a vanilla experience while still bringing the option of automation, technical mods and complex contraptions.

Building and the Create mod are the heart of this modpack, which is tied together with a careful selection of generation, exploration and immersion mods.
